title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: CDR > EAC > WavMerge > Soundforge (on d2t12) > CD-Wave > TLH v.1.0.0.72 (for SBE-OK, FLAC compression, and checksums) > FLAC
source: "Recorded by Tiger Rose, FOB Nak shotgun mics > Sony TC-D5. MAC > CD Analog to Digital transfer by David Howard."

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience FOB captures a high‑energy 1982 show with standout Crazy Fingers, Playing in the Band jam and the first Touch of Grey encore.
ai_review.review: The recording is an outstanding audience capture that puts you right in the middle of the crowd – crystal‑clear mics, vivid ambience and a sense of being onstage.  Musically the night shines with a unique first set, a fiery Shakedown → Playing in the Band sequence, an epic Space/NFA jam and the historic first Touch of Grey as an encore.  Overall the performance is high‑energy and tightly executed, making this one of the best early‑80s FOB releases.

ai_rating.rationale: 9 reviews are overwhelmingly positive (average 4.56 stars), praising both the show’s energy and the superb audience recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners describe the sound as crisp, on‑stage like, with clear instrument separation; feels like being in row 15. No major dropouts or distortion noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A unique, well‑played first set followed by a second set that builds from Shakedown into an expansive Playing jam, then a tight Space/NFA segment and a memorable Touch of Grey encore.

band_member_comments.Drums: One reviewer felt the drums were only average after the first set, but overall drum work was not criticized.
